_doc: Deepwater reference palette (TERRAIN_SPEC.md section 12.2, sRGB hex). data/palette.json holds the full Deepwater role set; content/biomes/<id>.json files override the platform/walkway/fog/void roles for their act and inherit every other role from here (DESIGN.md section 10). Emission factors are stated in the section 12.2 notes and kept next to the hex. Checker rule, texel density, slab heights and the trim band are section 12.2 facts. The fog-readability thresholds of section 12.3 are intentionally NOT copied here - tools/fog_check.gd (T-011) implements section 12.3 from the spec directly.

fog.note: exponential depth fog, density 0.012 per u

walkway_light.note: emission 0.35 x albedo; TERRAIN_SPEC section 12.2 states #2A5BFF, which fails the section 12.3 fog check at 60 u (2.737 < 3.0) - see DECISIONS D-T011-6

slab_trim.note: top 0.125 u of the slab side

launch_pad.note: top face; emission pulses 0.5-1.5 at 1 Hz

jump_pad.note: D-JUMPPAD-5, -9: the jump pad slab (NOT the launch pad tile): saturated glossy semi-transparent blue, emission 0.9 armed / 0.2 re-arming, 1 Hz pulse, 2.9 u across so it covers the whole 3x3 block; view/jump_pad_view.gd mirrors it

tripmine_particles.note: the only pink in the level

ambient.note: no sun, no directional shadows. D-ATMO-3: 2.6 -> 1.0. The 2.6 never reached the scene - fog_env.resolve_palette dropped the energy key, so every level rendered at the 1.0 fallback (now fixed). 1.0 is what the owner has been seeing, it reads the slab detail next to the void glow and the player fill, and it keeps the lobby antechamber (ambient x 2.0) exactly as lit as before. With the cloud dome the scene is dim and the emissive tiles, gifts and beacon are the bright accents (the reference mood)

player_fill_light.note: follows the player; range 18 -> 26 so the lit pool covers a causeway span, not just the player's feet

void_glow.note: one soft overhead directional light, shadows OFF (the ambient note's 'no directional shadows' still holds). Added because the near-black ambient plus an 18 u fill left everything past the player's feet black, so the slab detail could not be seen. 0.55 -> 0.3 with the cloud dome (D-ATMO-3): a dim key, not a flat wash

checker.grain_note: per-texel value noise +/-6% lightness (hash of texel coords; static, not animated)

sky._doc: Procedural cloud dome (view/sky_dome.gd, DECISIONS D-ATMO-1). A vertical horizon -> zenith gradient, hard-edged fbm cloud billows in `cloud`, a broad dark mass in the lower sky and a horizontal streak band in `cloud_dark`. Drawn unfogged behind everything; it follows the camera. drift_speed scales the cloud scroll (1.0 = the reference rate). View-only: never read by the sim, the state hash or tools/fog_check.gd.

debris._doc: Floating contour-outlined rocks (view/debris.gd, DECISIONS D-ATMO-2). Placed from the level seed in a ring around the level origin, min_radius..max_radius u out (the level radius is 70 + 2t <= 130 u, voidgen tuning) and min_height..max_height u up/down. size = the rock's radius in u. drift_speed = the whole field's orbit about Y in rad/s; spin_speed = max per-rock tumble in rad/s; bob = vertical bob amplitude in u. outline = an inverted hull grown outline_width SCREEN pixels (a world-space width is sub-pixel at 170-300 u), unshaded outline_hex. No collision, no sim state, no fog (they sit past the fog's reach).
